## Database preparation

The first step is to prepare the database and clean it

```{r}
library(haven)
library(survey)
CMS_DATA_BG <- haven::read_sav("CMS_RALITS_CORRECTION.sav", user_na = TRUE)

head(CMS_DATA_BG)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
CMS_DATA_BG <- CMS_DATA_BG %>%
  mutate(

    missing_key = if_else(
      is.na(D2) | D2 >= 99 |                  # Age
      is.na(D1) | !(D1 %in% c(1, 2)) |        # Sex
      is.na(D26) | !(D26 %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4)), # Settlement
      1, 0
    ),

  )

df_clean <- CMS_DATA_BG %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      D2 >= 18 & D2 <= 24 ~ "18-24",
      D2 <= 34 ~ "25-34",
      D2 <= 44 ~ "35-44",
      D2 <= 54 ~ "45-54",
      D2 <= 64 ~ "55-64",
      D2 >= 65 ~ "65+"
    ),
    sex = factor(D1, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Male", "Female"))
  )
```

```{r}
# Distributions
table(df_clean$age_group)
table(df_clean$sex)
```

## Post-strat weights construction

```{r}
library(eurostat)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
pop_raw <- get_eurostat("demo_pjan", time_format = "num")

bg_pop <- pop_raw %>%
  filter(
    geo == "BG",
   TIME_PERIOD== 2025,              # survey year
    sex %in% c("M", "F"),
age %in% c(paste0("Y", 18:99), "Y_GE90")
  )
```

```{r}
bg_pop_age_sex <- bg_pop %>%
  mutate(
    age_num = case_when(
      age == "Y_GE90" ~ 90,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(sub("^Y", "", age))
    ),
    sex = recode(sex,
      "M" = "Male",
      "F" = "Female"
    ),
    age_group = case_when(
      age_num >= 18 & age_num <= 24 ~ "18-24",
      age_num >= 25 & age_num <= 34 ~ "25-34",
      age_num >= 35 & age_num <= 44 ~ "35-44",
      age_num >= 45 & age_num <= 54 ~ "45-54",
      age_num >= 55 & age_num <= 64 ~ "55-64",
      age_num >= 65               ~ "65+"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%
  group_by(age_group, sex) %>%
  summarise(pop = sum(values, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Freq = pop / sum(pop))

bg_pop_age_sex
```

```{r}
pop_sex <- bg_pop_age_sex %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(pop = sum(pop), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Freq = pop / sum(pop))

pop_sex

sum(bg_pop_age_sex$Freq)

```

```{r}

sample_age_sex <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(age_group, sex) %>%
  summarise(n_sample = n(), .groups = "drop")

weight_table <- sample_age_sex %>%
  merge(bg_pop_age_sex, by = c("age_group", "sex"), all.x = TRUE)

weight_table <- weight_table %>%
  mutate(
    sample_share = n_sample / sum(n_sample),
    pop_share    = Freq / sum(Freq),
    weight       = pop_share / sample_share
  )

df_clean <- merge(
  df_clean,
  weight_table[, c("age_group", "sex", "weight")],
  by = c("age_group", "sex"),
  all.x = TRUE
)
```

### **some checks**

```{r}
# Check key uniqueness in weight table
any(duplicated(weight_table[, c("age_group", "sex")]))

# Check missing weights
table(is.na(df_clean$weight))

# Check weight distribution
summary(df_clean$weight)

# Check one weight per cell
aggregate(weight ~ age_group + sex, data = df_clean, function(x) length(unique(x)))

# Compare weighted sample shares to population shares
weighted_shares <- xtabs(weight ~ age_group + sex, data = df_clean)
weighted_shares <- weighted_shares / sum(weighted_shares)

pop_shares <- xtabs(Freq ~ age_group + sex, data = bg_pop_age_sex)
pop_shares <- pop_shares / sum(pop_shares)

weighted_shares
pop_shares

# Mean weight
mean(df_clean$weight, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
set.seed(123) 

df_clean[sample(nrow(df_clean), 10), 
         c("age_group", "sex", "weight")]
```

```{r}
write_sav(df_clean,"CMS_BG_RALITSA_WEIGHTED.sav")
```
